dialogue_texts: Doromi
Ah... ahahaha! Splendid! Truly, the power of your boundaries is nothing short of breathtaking.
Kaguya
Your brush has run dry, and your 'grand canvas' is tearing at the seams.
Kaguya
Are you ready to explain your little parallel experiment...
Kaguya
Or do I need to send you back to the library for reflection?
Doromi
Let us see if your light can pierce the eternal shroud!
Kaguya
Oh dear, are we repeating lines now?
Kaguya
A script loop is a terribly unoriginal way to concede defeat.
Kaguya
I told you before, little scribe.
Kaguya
You cannot smudge a history that has already seen a thousand nights like this one.
Kaguya
Stop resetting the conversation and look around you.
Doromi
Heh... You think you've won just because you cleared my danmaku?
Doromi
The Order's roots run deeper than this cemetery, My Majesty.
Doromi
Your beautiful, continuous evening will be swallowed by the ink of our rewrite!
Kaguya
Ink fades, paper decays, and stories end.
Kaguya
The moon always returns to an empty sky.
Kaguya
You're trying to rewrite a play that has no audience left to watch it.
Kaguya
It is time for your curtain call.
